notes: The *nor* of t021 fuses s015 (waw) and s017 (`לֹא`) under rule 35, headed on the negative; the intervening `עֹלָה` does not break the fusion, since the one English word still carries both the coordination and the negation.
The earlier `לֹא` (s013) is separately aligned to the written *not*, its verb keeping the auxiliary and lexical verb.
